structureReasons.GenericPlayerTerm: Installed Stardew Valley 1.6.15 IL loads this localized key in both purchased-item dialogue methods, splits it on a bare caret, defaults to index 0, and selects index 1 for a female player. The two resulting values are passed as {0} to the greeting 'Hey, {0}.', so Czech intentionally adds the runtime-supported male/female vocative branch farmáři^farmářko.
